(b) Suppose that one person in 100,000 has a particular disease. There is a test for the
disease that gives a positive result 90% of the time when given to someone with the
disease. When given to someone without the disease, 95% of the time it gives a negative
result. Find
(1) the probability that a person who tests positive has the disease. (2 points)
(2) the probability that a person who tests negative does not have the disease. (3
points)
Hint: Make use of the Bayes' theorem.
